name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne Morning Buttermilk Pancakes, Scrambled Eggs & Bacon Platter
whyItWorks: One of the easiest mobile-order hot breakfasts in Disneyland: soft buttermilk pancakes, fluffy scrambled eggs, and bacon with zero spicy sauces or roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pancake Platter with scrambled eggs and bacon (skip the seasonal berry compote if it has seeds and use plain maple syrup).
watchOuts: Pancakes contain buttermilk—take a lactase enzyme if needed
